title: soft10.io/en/whatsapp-api-pricing
snippet:
Since July 1, 2025 Meta charges per delivered message, by category and recipient country. For Azerbaijani numbers (Rest of Central & Eastern Europe) marketing costs **$0.0860** and utility, authentication or service costs **$0.0212** (rate card effective October 1, 2026). The first 1,000 service messages per number each month are free. Soft10 plans start at 29 USD per month.

### Soft10: subscription plus template fee
Soft10 charges a monthly subscription (29 USD, 58 USD and 117 USD, Enterprise on request) and a small fee per template message you send. The inbox, CRM and automation are included within plan limits.

### 1,000 free service messages
From October 1, 2026 each business phone number has a free tier of 1,000 delivered service messages per month. Unused messages do not roll over. If no payment method is added and the tier is used up, service messages are not delivered.

What stays free
## What stays free
- ### Incoming messages
Messages that customers send to you are not charged.
- ### The first 1,000 service messages
Per business phone number and per month, delivered messages only.
- ### The free entry point window
When a customer taps a Click-to-WhatsApp ad and you reply inside Meta's free entry point window, marketing, utility, authentication and service messages are not charged. Meta sets the length of that window and can change it, so check Meta's pricing page.
- ### Anything not delivered
Meta charges only for delivered messages.

### Is the WhatsApp Business API free?
API access is free, and Soft10 offers a 7-day free trial. You pay Meta for delivered marketing, utility and authentication messages, and for service messages beyond the first 1,000 per phone number each month. Inbound messages and messages inside Meta's free entry point window are not charged.

title: WhatsApp Cloud API Pricing 2026: Per Message, Not Per Conversation
snippet:
WhatsApp Cloud API pricing is per message, not per conversation. Since 1 July 2025 Meta charges each delivered message on its own, by category (marketing, utility, authentication, service or Meta Business Agent) and the recipient's country, instead of billing a 24-hour conversation as one unit. For example, a marketing template costs £0.0458 in the UK and €0.1131 in Germany, and a utility template £0.0159 and €0.0456. Below are the current rates for five markets, read from Meta's rate card, plus what changed on 1 October 2026 and what is still free.
## Short answer
Meta charges for marketing, utility and authentication templates, and for service messages after a free tier. These are Meta's own list rates, not Blueticks prices. If you use the Cloud API directly, Meta bills you; providers such as Twilio bill you themselves and may add their own fee.

title: WhatsApp Business API Pricing 2026
snippet:
WhatsApp Business API pricing confuses almost everyone the first time. There's no monthly fee from Meta, no per-seat price, and no single "cost per message". What you pay depends on **who you're messaging, what kind of message it is, and how many you send**.

Meta moved the WhatsApp Business Platform from conversation-based pricing to **per-message pricing** in 2025. Each delivered template message is billed on its own. Two things set the price:
1. **The recipient's country.** Meta groups countries into markets using the recipient's phone number country code. Large markets such as India, Brazil, Germany or the UK have their own rates. Smaller countries fall into regional groups such as "Rest of Western Europe" or "Rest of Africa". The United States and Canada share one "North America" rate.
2. **The message category.** Every message template you create is approved into a category, and each category has its own price.

Meta publishes rate cards in US dollars and 15 other billing currencies, including EUR, GBP, INR, BRL and IDR. Rates can change on **January 1, April 1, July 1 and October 1**, and Meta announces changes in advance on its [pricing page](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/pricing).

## What's free on the WhatsApp Business API?
Quite a lot, if you plan for it:
- **1,000 service messages per business phone number, every month.** Each business number gets its own allowance, and the count resets monthly.
- **Messages in a free entry point window.** When a customer messages you through a Click-to-WhatsApp ad or a Facebook Page call-to-action button, a free entry point window opens and can stay open for up to 7 days. Messages you send in it, templates included, are free and don't count toward volume tiers. Meta Business Agent messages, which are priced by tokens, are still charged.
- **Customer-initiated messages.** Messages customers send to you are never charged.

From Oct 1, 2026
1,000 free, then charged
Each business phone number gets 1,000 free service messages per month. After that, service messages are charged at the market's service rate.

- Tiers are **per market and per month**, and reset on the first of each month.
- Tiers count charged messages across your whole business portfolio (all its WhatsApp Business Accounts), not per phone number. Free messages don't count.
- **Marketing and service messages have no volume tiers.**

title: WhatsApp Business API pricing in October 2026
snippet:
Meta charges per delivered message sent from a business to a user. The price depends on two things: the message category (marketing, utility, authentication or service) and the country calling code of the recipient. Messages from customers to you are free, and you pay only when a message is delivered, not when it is sent.
This replaced the old per-conversation model on 1 July 2025. Every delivered message now carries exactly one charge, set by its category. Meta’s own worked example has five delivered messages and five charges, even when they all happen inside one hour.
| Category | What it is | How you send it | Typical use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marketing | Template messages with a promotional goal | Template, any time | Offers, launches, abandoned-cart nudges, re-engagement |
| Utility | Template messages with a transactional or informational goal | Template, any time | Order and delivery updates, appointment reminders, receipts |
| Authentication | Template messages that verify identity | Template, any time | One-time passcodes, login codes |
| Service | Any non-template reply not powered by Meta’s own AI agent | Free-form, only inside the 24-hour customer service window | Answering a customer who just wrote to you |
Meta added a fifth category in 2026, Meta Business Agent, for replies written by Meta’s own AI platform. It is priced per token, at $2.00 per million tokens, which Meta says is about 4 to 5 US cents per message. Replies from a third-party AI or from your own agents are service messages.

Three kinds. Messages from customers to you are always free. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number each month are free; billing starts at the 1,001st. And every message inside a free entry-point window, opened when you reply to a customer who clicked a Click-to-WhatsApp ad, is free for up to 7 days.
### The 1,000 free service messages
Meta gives each business phone number 1,000 free service messages a month. They do not roll over; the count resets monthly, at midnight in your Messaging account’s time zone. This took effect on 1 October 2026 as Meta resumed charging for service replies, which had been free since 1 November 2024. After the free tier, a service message is billed at the service rate for the customer’s country, which for every market in the table below is the same figure as the utility rate.

title: WhatsApp Business API Pricing 2026: Per-Message Rates
snippet:
**The WhatsApp Business API is billed per delivered message, by category and by the recipient's country.** For the United States, Meta's rate card lists $0.025 per marketing message and $0.0034 per utility, authentication or service message. Since October 1, 2026, Meta charges again for service messages beyond 1,000 a month per number.

| Market | Marketing | Utility and authentication | Service, after 1,000 free |
|---|---|---|---|
| North America (US, Canada) | $0.0250 | $0.0034 | $0.0034 |
| United Arab Emirates | $0.0576 | $0.0157 | $0.0157 |
| Saudi Arabia | $0.0576 | $0.0107 | $0.0107 |
| India | $0.0118 | $0.0014 | $0.0014 |
| United Kingdom | $0.0635 | $0.0220 | $0.0220 |

| Mexico | $0.0397 | $0.0085 | $0.0085 |

## Is the WhatsApp Business API free?
Partly. What costs nothing:
- **Receiving messages.** Customers write to you for free, and Meta does not charge you for incoming messages. Some providers do (see below).
- **The first 1,000 service messages** per business phone number per month. They reset monthly and do not roll over.
- **Replies to a Click to WhatsApp ad.** When someone messages you from one of these ads, your first reply opens a window of up to 7 days in which marketing, utility, authentication and service messages are not charged.
Everything else is billed: every template, and every service message from the 1,001st. If you only want to chat with customers from one phone, the WhatsApp Business app is free; the API is for connecting WhatsApp to your own systems.
## What changed on October 1, 2026
Meta's own words: it "resumed charging, on a per-message basis, for messages that were previously free":
- **Service messages**, free since November 1, 2024, are charged again **from the 1,001st per month**. In the current rate card the service rate equals each market's utility rate.
- **Utility messages sent in reply to a customer**, inside an open customer service window, free since July 1, 2025, are charged again.

Per message. Under the old model, Meta charged once per 24-hour conversation, and the first 1,000 service conversations a month per business account were free. That model is deprecated: a provider quoting you "per conversation" in 2026 is using out-of-date pricing, and its free tier no longer exists in that form.
